carmen (Product PM): Short convo: customers keep asking about explicit model fallback guarantees and how we handle quantized variants across regions. Need a succinct spec paragraph.

kevin (Platform Eng): We should guarantee that fallback follows an ordered chain: preferred full-precision model in region -> quantized variant in same region -> compatible model in nearby region -> global cheap fallback. All with safety checks.

rachel (SRE): And add observability: fallback reason code should be logged and surfaced in Console. Also require a 10-minute cooldown for auto-fallbacks to avoid flapping.

carmen (Product PM): Good. I'll include that in the playbook. infra-bot created task RD-88 for fallback-spec
